brief:
Hearing aid batteries the size of lentils have become a critical shortage in Gaza, compounding hardship for people with hearing disabilities, Shehab Wire reported. The territory has restricted imports of the devices while supplies dwindle and auditory rehabilitation services decline.

The convergence of an import ban, device scarcity, and deteriorating rehabilitation infrastructure has left deaf and hard-of-hearing residents without adequate access to equipment essential for communication and social participation.
